summary_en: NRI acquired 3,746,100 shares (0.67% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at 6,025 yen per share on November 20, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3, totaling approximately 22.6 billion yen. The shares were purchased to mitigate short-term market impact from a shareholder's planned sale of 3,121,800 shares held by Seven-Eleven Japan. NRI will cancel 3,121,800 shares on November 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decisions on Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Auction Trading (ToSTNeT-3) and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 19, 2026, NRI's Board of Directors authorized the execution of a treasury stock acquisition via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3). The acquisition was executed on November 20, 2026 at the closing price of 6,025 yen per share through ToSTNeT-3 at 8:45 a.m. JST. NRI purchased 3,746,100 shares, representing 0.67% of issued shares excluding treasury stock (560,101,089 shares as of November 19, 2026), for a total of approximately 22.6 billion yen. The stated reason for the acquisition was to mitigate short-term market impact from a shareholder's planned sale and to minimize the impact on existing shareholders.

The acquisition was executed to respond to a sale notice from Seven-Eleven Japan Co., Ltd., which informed NRI of its intention to sell 3,121,800 shares held by the company. By purchasing these shares through the market, NRI sought to stabilize supply and demand dynamics.

Following the acquisition, NRI will cancel 3,121,800 shares (representing 0.56% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) with an effective date of November 30, 2026. The remaining acquired shares will be retained as treasury stock. This cancellation will reduce the total number of issued shares outstanding.
